scope: Phase 1 H3 timer/alignment evidence only; excludes Phase 2 changes, Phase 3, formal Case creation, and fault experiments.

authorization.source: explicit user authorization for bounded H3 recapture

timing.independent_start_method: persistent read-only UART reader opened before one UID-pinned pyOCD reset; a no-reset SWD attach wrote the one permitted capture gate before DSView was confirmed armed

frozen_configuration.pin_channel_semantics: CH0=PC2 EPOCH; CH1=PC3 CALIBRATION_TIMER; CH2=PC4; CH3=PC5; CH4=PC6; CH5=PC7; CH6=PB5; CH7=PB0 LCD_BL; green LED=PE5.
frozen_configuration.observer_profile: CH0-CH7; 20 MHz; 5 s; CH0 rising; threshold 1.6 V; no external sampling clock

shared_epoch_unique_and_unambiguous.evidence: gate receipt and UART record one verified epoch sequence=1

observer_complete_and_parseable.evidence: DSView was not confirmed armed before the one-time gate; no DSL, CSV, or screenshot was produced

trace_or_secondary_record_complete.evidence: UART raw and gate receipt are retained

pin_channel_semantics_phase1_pinmap_v3.evidence: No Observer capture exists to verify channel semantics

raw_and_calculation_bound.evidence: Observer raw artifacts and calculation inputs are absent

acceptance.failure_reason: DSView was not confirmed armed before the single gate write, so the CH0 epoch was missed. This failed attempt is retained and excluded from the H3 passing-session count.
